events.name: hostRefreshStarted
events.description: One catalogue refresh began. trace joins its route attempts and final result.

events.name: hostRouteStarted
events.description: One bounded way into a host began. This is a lifecycle record, never a request log.

events.name: hostRouteProgress
events.description: One coarse, bounded stage inside an already-started route attempt.

events.name: hostDoorBound
events.description: One door of the host listener set started answering on its addresses.

events.name: hostDoorUnreachable
events.description: One enabled door has nothing listening for it. The reason field says why.

events.name: hostIdentityCreated
events.description: The Mac minted the identity its listeners present. detail carries only a short fingerprint hash.

events.name: hostIdentityReset
events.description: The listener identity was replaced, unpairing devices without a rotation announcement.

events.name: hostIdentityRotated
events.description: A prepared successor identity became the identity the listeners present.

events.name: hostDiscoveryRegistered
events.description: The Mac began advertising its listener; origin is a hash, never an address or instance name.

events.name: hostDiscoveryFound
events.description: A client saw a Threading service; peer is a pseudonym and no address or instance name is recorded.

events.name: terminalAttachEnded
events.description: The host finished attaching one socket to a session or terminal: hello sent, bounded replay handed to the connection. durationMS is the host-side attach cost; kind is session or terminal.

events.name: terminalHydrationEnded
events.description: The host ended one session terminal's resize hydration: the hold between a phone's first grid and its terminalReady boundary. durationMS is the hold, reason is quiet, firstOutputTimeout, ceiling, noResize or cancelled, total counts the output bursts seen during it, and detail names the agent runtime.

events.name: socketReconnectScheduled
events.description: A failed live socket scheduled one bounded exponential retry.

events.name: sessionResumeStarted
events.description: A parked authenticated session socket began reattaching to its live surface.

events.name: sessionResumeEnded
events.description: A parked session reattach reached a terminal result with its own duration, separate from socket age.

events.name: sessionOpenStarted
events.description: A person opened one chat. trace joins its progress and result; detail names the agent runtime.

events.name: sessionOpenProgress
events.description: One fixed stage of a chat opening (catalogue, wake, socket, hello) was reached. durationMS is cumulative from the tap.

events.name: sessionOpenEnded
events.description: A chat opening became usable, failed or was abandoned. durationMS is tap to usable; reason says whether it was pooled, fresh or woken; phase names how the surface was revealed.

events.name: promptSubmissionStarted
events.description: A content-free prompt or atomic terminal submission began.

events.name: promptSubmissionEnded
events.description: A prompt or atomic terminal submission reached an acknowledgement or terminal failure.

events.name: terminalInputProbeStarted
events.description: One rate-limited direct-terminal input latency probe began; it contains no input bytes.

events.name: terminalInputProbeEnded
events.description: A sampled direct-terminal input reached host admission or timed out.

events.name: notificationDeliveryTransition
events.description: A content-free host delivery decision. phase carries the closed transition name.

events.name: attachmentPreviewFailed
events.description: A phone attachment preview attempt reached a terminal failure. kind and code remain structural tokens.

fields.name: phase
fields.description: A fixed stage such as refresh, prepare, request, hello, or backoff.

fields.name: networkStage
fields.description: The coarse URL-loading phase reached by one bounded request.

fields.name: networkProtocol
fields.description: A fixed URLSession protocol token, never an address or URL.

fields.name: networkPath
fields.description: A fixed URLSession path token, never an interface name or URL.

fields.name: wave
fields.description: The fixed pass of a bounded walk, such as route, address, or port.

fields.name: origin
fields.description: A truncated address hash: origin- followed by twelve lowercase hexadecimal digits.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: A bounded machine token qualifying code or reason; never prose or a path.

extraFields.name: connectionStateHistory
extraFields.description: A bounded ring of connection-state transitions behind the snapshot state.

extraFields.name: attachmentPreviewHistory
extraFields.description: A bounded ring of attachment-preview attempt outcomes using closed kind and outcome tokens.

extraFields.name: connectionPoolMetrics
extraFields.description: The warm session-connection pool's counters since their last reset, as closed key.value tokens.
